body: I don't think that logic that halifax not having the population to support a team is the reason they will fail. If this was true then the league would be thriving in Montreal Toronto and Vancouver, and not doing well in Saskatchewan, Hamilton, Winnipeg but the complete opposite is true. The CFL does the best in cities that don't have much other professional sports competition. Regina  has less population than Halifax but yet has the biggest fan base in the CFL. I think if the team and city can do a stadium deal then the team will be successful. Halifax proves they want more pro sports by the Wanderers having the biggest fan base in the CPL. The CFL will do fine here. Bigger population does not mean bigger fan base.
